<a id="mission"></a>

## Mission

Fix B-1: a daemon-spawned seat that registers must ADOPT its pre-bind row instead of minting a second one. Today two rows share one pane and one spawn_id, and the rpc_port stamped on the pre-bind row is lost — so the live row a consumer reads carries no port. The root cause is already found; you are implementing a ruled fix, not searching for one.

<a id="instructions"></a>

## Instructions

| id | text |
| --- | --- |
| i1 | ROOT CAUSE, verbatim, already accepted by the o-prime — do not re-derive it: crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:366-370 adopts the pre-bind row by SEAT ID ALONE (`seats.iter().find(\|seat\| seat.id == claimed_id)`). The pre-bind row was created under an allocated MEMORABLE id (allocate_memorable_id at :443/:649) and the registering process claims a DIFFERENT id, so the find misses and a fresh descriptor is minted while the allocated row is stranded. Worse: :371-376 computes binds_spawned_incarnation from a spawn_id match, but only AFTER the id-keyed find has already failed, so at :400 the fresh rpc_port_intent is CLEARED on the very registration it was stamped for. |
| i2 | RULED FIX DIRECTION (o-prime, not open for re-litigation): adopt on spawn_id (+pane) when the id lookup misses. That is one lookup change plus its port-preservation consequence. It must NOT become a redesign, and it must not touch the seat-descriptor shape or the register request/response — those are the seam. |
| i3 | Live evidence of the defect: allocated pij-irregular-apocalypse vs a second row pij-empirical-caribou, same pane %1963, same spawn_id. |
| i4 | The predecessor tombstoning at :407-425 already exists for the native-session-boundary case. Understand it before you touch adoption — you must not turn an adoption into a tombstone, or an ordinary re-registration will start dissolving live seats. |
| i5 | Load BOTH the pij skill and the builder skill and act from those contracts, not from CLI help. |
| i6 | Report at both edges with `pij report now`. Questions come to pij-fatal-woodpecker inline via `pij send pij-fatal-woodpecker` — NEVER a modal question dialog in your pane: a modal in an unwatched pane is a process stopped with nothing anywhere saying so. |
| i7 | Raise any seam or contract objection AT THE ACK, before you have built against it. The window is widest when nothing is built. If you find the ruled fix direction is unsound, that reason comes to me — it does not get absorbed into a workaround. |
| i8 | Run the gate as `~/.cargo/bin/cargo run -p pij-testkit --bin pij-gate`. A bare `cargo` on this machine is NOT the rustup shim and silently runs rustc 1.95.0 against a 1.98.0 pin; the gate's own toolchain stage catches it. All stages must be green, unfiltered, with cargo's own exit code. |
